# SPARCED Precursor (Bouhaddou 2018)

This page outlines the steps taken to replicate the results from
[_A mechanistic pan-cancer pathway model informed by multi-omics data interprets stochastic cell fate responses to drugs and mitogens_](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article%3Fid%3D10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005985)
by Mehdi Bouhaddou et al., published in 2018.
It includes details on the experimental setup, data preprocessing, code execution, and any deviations or clarifications needed to match the original findings.
